sources.entry: Feedy - An elegant and lightweight RSS client and news reader for your Mac. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/feedy-rss-client/id588288104?ls=1&platform=mac)

summary.name: Feedy
summary.one_liner: Feedy is a lightweight RSS client and news reader for macOS that ranks feed items by how many tweets mention them.
use_cases: Following news and blogs in one place on a Mac
Finding the most talked-about articles from feeds
Catching rare posts from small websites that rarely update
Importing or exporting feed subscriptions via OPML
summary.what_it_does: Feedy is an RSS client that rates each feed item using the number of tweets mentioning the article, and gives higher ratings to feeds that update infrequently. It offers clutter-free reading of full-length articles with automatic or per-feed reading mode selection. Users can limit feeds to their most popular stories, highlight stories matching personal keywords, and view all feeds as one stream or sorted into folders. Notifications and a menu bar icon that glows when new items arrive are supported on macOS.
notable: Popularity ratings based on tweet counts for each story
Clutter-free reader with per-feed reading mode
caveats: Mac only; the page names no other platforms
Popularity ratings depend on tweet data
